correctness.rationale: Automorphism averaging is valid for the operator norm objective; Johnson A1^2 identity and inclusion filtration give exact three nontrivial eigenmodes. Rational dual weights and primal equalities prove sharp branches 6..9 and 10..12, while the first-mode bound proves n>=13, with explicit polynomial inequalities for unused modes. Every nonnegative-entry optimizer inherits edge/diagonal zero constraints from its unique invariant average. Standalone exact replay passed 995 parameter checks and five complete adjacency-square reconstructions.

value.rationale: The natural three-item exchange chain on merged Johnson graphs receives an all-size closed-form spectral optimum and two sharp support transitions: single replacement ceases at n=10 and holding ceases at n=13. The first transition is forced for all unrestricted optimizers, not only a symmetric ansatz. Exact finite-size transition laws add substantive design content beyond merely solving individual LP samples.
